question.text: The minimum net worth requirement for a non-bank trading member in ETCD is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 193, trading members are subject to a balance sheet net worth requirement of Rs. 1 crore, while clearing members must have Rs. 10 crores. The non-bank trading-member figure is therefore Rs. 1 crore. The Trap: Rs. 10 crores is the clearing-member threshold, not the trading-member threshold. Note: Page 206 supports the bank trading-member prudential net worth of Rs. 500 crores, which is a separate (and much higher) requirement.
